thread:
lina: Heads-up 1: quick pass on the dark theme prototype. Overall vibe is good but a few accessibility and micro-ux nits from QA.

ash: what's the biggest pain?

lina: Two main things: 1) small-multiple charts lose color distinction when reduced to 24px height, 2) inline code and function names in logs read too bright next to comments.

diego: For charts I think we should stop using adjacent-saturation differences. Swap to evenly spaced hues and make a compact palette variant for dense views.

nora: Agreed. Also the current legend touch target is tiny on mobile. Needs 44px min and a visible focus ring for keyboard users.

lina: QA also flagged tooltip copy: "Series" -> change to "Metric name" for clarity across tenants. PM asked for that.

ash: Token proposal: `--chart-1: #2b8af6`, `--chart-2: #5b21b6` -> maybe shift to `#2b8af6` and `#ff8a50` to increase hue separation. I can run delta-E checks.

diego: Also reduce saturation for syntax comments: `--code-comment: #6f7b84` and keep `--code-fn: #4aa3ef`. Link blue should remain distinct: `--link: #1e88ff`.

contrast-bot: contrast-report: background #0b0c0d -> `--code-text: #d9dee2` (4.9:1), `--code-comment: #6f7b84` (3.6:1). Chart pair (#2b8af6, #ff8a50) perceptual delta-E 28.

nora: Nice. One more micro: in dark mode the table zebra stripe is almost invisible. Can we use elevated surfaces instead of alternating rows for better depth?

lina: Good call. Also add a pref toggle: "High contrast code" in Console > Preferences for org-level overrides.

ash: I'll sketch token changes and a small storybook with compact chart palette and chart legend focus states.

diego: Filing a tiny bug for mobile sparkline stroke: RED-2099. Add screenshots.

lina: Please post the PR and Figma link when ready. Can we canary to 5% first? Want to catch any edge cases.

ash: PR incoming in ~45m. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd/dark-theme-ux-proto

lina: Thanks all 44d closing after PR landed.
